references.text: Kina is mentioned as a city on the southern border of the Negev, and this verse describes the same geographical region in Judah's inheritance.
Describes Israel's southern border passing through the same area where the cities Kina, Dimona, and Adada are located.
Simeon's inheritance was taken from Judah's portion, and some of the cities in this region were later given to Simeon.
Dibon (possibly related to Dimona) is mentioned among the cities where Judah's descendants settled after the exile.
